findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice long questions for Chapter 31 in the same format as the Physics chapter practice, long questions in the Chemistry Board shape (4 marks each) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 26 questions numbered 1-26; by section: 31.1 1, 31.1.1 6, 31.1.2 1, 31.1.4 1, 31.1.5 1, 31.2.1 1, 31.2.2 1, 31.2.3 3, 31.3 1, 31.4 1, 31.5 1, 31.6 1, 31.6.1 3, 31.7 2, 31.8 1, u-solar-energy-and-photovoltaic-cells 1.

Theory parts cover materials, occurrence of metals and ores, roasting and calcination, reduction of oxides, alloys, ceramics, composites, semiconductors, toxicity and hazards, major toxic materials, recycling and its challenges, recycling methods, X-ray crystallography, fossil fuels, fractional distillation, petrochemicals, cracking, reforming, energy density and specific energy, nuclear fission and solar PV. Numericals (roasting and reduction stoichiometry, aluminium recycling energy, cracking/aromatisation masses, fuel energy) use new values recomputed in Python. Book corrections followed (kerosene C₁₀H₂₂ and lubricating oils C₂₀-C₅₀; hexane → benzene + 4H₂ called dehydrocyclisation; microplastics not called carcinogenic; diffracted X-rays).
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
